item.title: GAC launches GS4 Max HEV
item.description: GAC Motor Philippines has launched the GS4 Max HEV, a five-seat hybrid SUV priced at ₱1.298 million. Customers who reserve the vehicle until 30 September 2026 can get it for an introductory price of ₱1.218 million, which represents savings of ₱80,000. The GS4 Max HEV uses a 2.0-liter Atkinson-cycle

item.title: BYD chairman visits Phl
item.description: BYD chairman and president Wang Chuanfu recently visited the Philippines to review the Chinese automaker’s local operations and meet its dealers, business partners and frontline staff.

item.title: Geely founder Li Shufu resigns
item.description: Geely Automobile founder Li Shufu has resigned as chairman and executive director of the Chinese carmaker as part of a major leadership change.

item.title: Lexus offers August buyers perks
item.description: Lexus Philippines is offering financing and ownership benefits on six models this August, and customers can choose from several available packages.

item.title: Nissan unveils all-new Kicks e-Power
item.description: Nissan Philippines will officially launch the all-new Kicks e-Power on 28 August at the Glorietta Palm Drive Activity Center in Makati City.

item.title: Mazda goes bigger
item.description: Mazda Philippines has launched the all-new 2027 CX-5 with a larger body, a roomier cabin and its first hybrid powertrain. The compact SUV comes in one 2.5L AWD HEV Premium Plus variant and costs P2,495,000.

item.title: ‘Rolling lab’ heads to BRC
item.description: LAST WEEKEND, the Toyota Gazoo Racing (TGR) Philippine Cup made its first-ever stop at the Batangas Racing Circuit (BRC). While the facility is smaller compared to the usual haunt of the grassroots race series, the Clark International Speedway, the BRC is considered a more difficult course.

item.title: Who Made The Geo (And Chevy) Tracker, And What Are These Tiny SUVs Worth Now?
item.description: The Geo Tracker has developed a reputation as a classic in recent years, which caused its value to increase. Here's who built the car and what it's worth today.
